title: Inf money and moon money
features:
Inf money and moon currency
simple to use
script:
local LoadingTick = os.clock()
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i77lhm/Libraries/refs/heads/main/Utopia/Library.lua"))()
local Window = Library:Window({
    Name = "Create a Factory",
    GradientTitle = {
        Enabled = true,
        Start = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Middle = Color3.fromRGB(0, 251, 255),
        End = Color3.fromRGB(50, 135, 168),
        Speed = 1
    }
})

local Watermark = Library:Watermark("Hi", {"77974153657891", Color3.fromRGB(149, 255, 139)})
local MoneyTab = Window:Page({Name = "Money", Columns = 2})

local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local base = player.Base.Value
local value = 9e9

local MoonSection = MoneyTab:Section({Name = "Inf money", Side = 1})

MoonSection:Textbox({
    Name = "Value",
    Flag = "Money",
    Default = tostring(value),
    Placeholder = "Amount",
    Callback = function(input)
        local number = tonumber(input)
        if number then
            value = number
            Library:Notification("Amount:" .. value, 2, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
        else
            Library:Notification("Invalid", 2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        end
    end
})

MoonSection:Button({
    Name = "Get money",
    Callback = function()
        rs.RemoveEvents.BuyMoonItem:FireServer(-value, "BlackHoleMachine")
        rs.RemoveEvents.SetupConveyorTouches:FireServer(value, 1)
        rs.RemoveEvents.SetupConveyorTouches:FireServer(value, 1)
        rs.RemoveEvents.SetupConveyorTouches:FireServer(base.PlacedPieces.Seller, value, 1)
        Library:Notification("Received: " .. value, 3, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0))
    end
})

Library:Notification("Loaded library in " .. string.format("%.4f", os.clock() - LoadingTick) .. " seconds", 5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), {"135757045959142", Color3.fromRGB(149, 255, 139)})
